text: Automatically captures and sends errors thrown by an instrumented application to Honeybadger's API
quote: Once our client library is installed and configured, errors thrown by your application are automatically sent to our API.

text: Lets you customize error grouping via error class, component, stack trace, or custom fingerprint
quote: You can customize the grouping for each exception by changing the error class name, component, or stack trace—or by sending a custom fingerprint.

text: Groups identical errors into one issue while letting you browse each individual occurrence
quote: Honeybadger groups identical errors together. Using our navigation bar, you can still navigate between each individual occurrence (or notice, as we also call them) of the error.

text: Supports a structured query syntax to filter errors by class, tag, component, and action
quote: Example query: `john class:UserError -tag:wip -tag:pending component:"UsersController" action:'update'`.

text: Lets you describe a search in plain language and have it generate the query for you
quote: You can search for errors without writing the query yourself. Click the lightbulb icon next to the search box to open the “Describe your search” panel, then describe what you want to find.

text: Automatically marks unresolved errors as resolved when a new deployment is recorded
quote: By default, all unresolved errors are automatically marked as resolved when a deployment is recorded, which helps keep your error list clean.

text: Links a deploy revision to a diff view showing code changes since the last deploy when GitHub/GitLab is connected
quote: When GitHub or GitLab is connected, Honeybadger links the revision to a comparison page that shows a diff of what changed since the last deploy.

text: Lets you define alarms combining a BadgerQL query with a threshold to trigger alerts
quote: Alarms combine a BadgerQL query (“count all slow requests in the past five minutes”) with a threshold (“when count is > 2”) and trigger alerts when the query result exceeds the threshold.

text: Anomaly detection alerts you when error volume deviates statistically from a learned baseline
quote: Anomaly detection alerts you when a project’s total error volume deviates from its learned baseline... notifies you when the current rate is statistically unusual (for example, “errors are 4.7× your normal rate”).

text: Notification messages include a button to resolve or reopen the error directly
quote: Messages about errors include a button to resolve or reopen the error

text: Official CLI command to show details of a specific fault by number
quote:
**show fault _<fault #>_**

See details about the requested fault. The fault number can be found in the Honeybadger UI.

text: Integrates with PagerDuty by generating a service integration key for alert routing
quote: You can generate an integration key for Honeybadger by logging in to PagerDuty then clicking on “Add New Service” and choosing “Honeybadger” as the service type.

text: Connecting via MCP gives an AI assistant project management, error investigation, and BadgerQL insight capabilities
quote: Once connected, your AI assistant gains the following capabilities: Project management... Error investigation... Insights: Run BadgerQL queries against your event data.

text: Hosted MCP server supports OAuth so agents can connect via browser approval instead of pasting credentials
quote: Our hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so you can connect an agent by approving access in your browser instead of copying and pasting a credential into a config file.

text: Errors can be submitted as a JSON payload via a documented POST endpoint
quote: Your JSON payload should be submitted as the body of a POST request to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices

text: Un-minifies JavaScript stack traces automatically when source maps are uploaded
quote: Honeybadger can automatically un-minify your JavaScript code if you provide a source map along with your minified files. Use the Source Map Upload API to upload your source maps to Honeybadger.

text: Provides an API endpoint to notify Honeybadger when a deploy occurs
quote: Use this endpoint to notify Honeybadger when a deploy occurs.

text: Ships an official command-line interface for Honeybadger-related tasks
quote: The Honeybadger CLI provides a Command Line Interface for various Honeybadger-related programs and utilities.

text: API endpoint returns a list of faults or a single fault for a given project
quote: Returns a list of faults or a single fault for the given project

text: Supports querying errors that occurred since the most recent deployment
quote:
`occurred.after:'last deploy'`

Errors that occurred since the most recent deployment

text: Supports SAML assertion attributes to map existing roles/teams into a Honeybadger project
quote: We added support for SAML assertion attributes, making team management even easier. Now, you can map already-existing roles and teams directly into your Honeybadger project.

text: Business/Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data to retain it longer than default storage
quote: If you need to keep your Insights data longer than Honeybadger stores it, Business and Enterprise accounts can now replicate

text: Detailed issue exports to GitHub, GitLab, or Jira include full markdown/wiki content
quote: We now support detailed issue exports to third-party managers. When enabled, your issue exports to GitHub or GitLab will contain the full markdown, or the full Jira wiki for JIRA Cloud and JIRA Server

text: Integrates with Oban to report unhandled worker exceptions and per-job telemetry to Insights
quote: Honeybadger now integrates with Oban (the Python port of the Elixir background job library). With this release you can report unhandled worker exceptions and emit per-job telemetry to Honeybadger Insights.

text: Requests from Honeybadger servers include a secret Honeybadger-Token header derived from the API key
quote: Requests sent from Honeybadger servers for source maps, web hooks, and uptime checks include the header Honeybadger-Token which is a secret token derived from your api key.
